architectureDecisions: D1 — commandSmoke forwards --model, --permission and --trace-dir into runSupervisedTask, copying commandRun's observation construction. permission = options.permission ?? PermissionProfile.WORKSPACE_EDIT; unknown values UsageError before mkdtemp. model = options.model ?? null. If options["trace-dir"] is set, createSupervisedObservation({ tool, arm: options.arm ?? "SMOKE", taskId: `smoke-${toolId}`, writer: createRunTraceWriter({ dir }) }) and pass invocationObserver/eventSinks/tracer; finalize after the run. --arm requires --trace-dir (same UsageError as commandRun). Default arm SMOKE so report can distinguish from EXHARNESS_SUPERVISED. DELIVERED_TRUTH: smokePassesModel false, smokePassesPermission false, smokePassesTraceDir false, smokeCallsRunSupervisedTask true.

D2 — Keep current smoke defaults when flags are omitted: no model, WORKSPACE_EDIT, no traces, maxAttempts 2, timeoutMs positiveInteger(--timeout-ms, 600000). Keep SKIPPED NOT_INSTALLED and TOOL_FAILED_BEFORE_EDIT print paths. No --recovery-dir on smoke. Do not write supervisor.js or observation.js.
D3 — USAGE smoke line gains [--model M] [--permission WORKSPACE_EDIT|FULL_AUTO] [--trace-dir <dir> [--arm <label>]]. Header comment matches.

D4 — Focused tests follow testContract: capture actual fake CLI argv for supplied and omitted model/permission; verify digest chain and invoke actual report; assert default SMOKE arm and no traces when omitted. Distinct invalid permission/arm and SKIPPED fixtures prove no dispatch and existing reasons. Never infer option forwarding from PASS alone.

D5 — Living docs. state.md smoke sentence names --model/--permission/--trace-dir, default arm SMOKE, --arm requires --trace-dir, SKIPPED reasons unchanged. observation.md CLI sentence adds smoke --trace-dir. No Blackboard ids.
D6 — Evidence at 5386e2ad: commandSmoke currently passes only maxAttempts 2 and timeoutMs.

After resolving tool and constructing task.id=smoke-${toolId}, create observation only when trace-dir supplied: createSupervisedObservation({tool,arm:options.arm??SMOKE,taskId:task.id,writer:createRunTraceWriter({dir})}). Pass model:options.model??null,permissionProfile:permission and conditional invocationObserver/eventSinks/tracer into existing runSupervisedTask call, preserving maxAttempts2/current timeout. Await observation.finalize(result) immediately after supervised result and before SKIPPED/result print; existing finally removes only smoke scratch, not caller trace dir. Add USAGE flags. Focused fake argv proves model/sandbox; readTraces/verifyTraceFile and actual report prove digest chain/default SMOKE arm, with corrupted trace rejected. No supervisor/observation source change.
